_comment: Price table for session cost estimation (B4). USD per MILLION tokens. PRICES GO STALE - that's why they live in config, not in code. Override in config/rates.local.json (gitignored), not here. As of 2026-07-24.
_cacheComment: Cache is priced with MULTIPLIERS off the input price, because that's how it's defined: read ~0.1x, write 1.25x (5 min TTL) or 2x (1h TTL). LunaCore assumes the default 5 min.
